products.body_html:
Meet the Classic Straight Leg Sweatpants, made from premium heavyweight fabric with a relaxed fit. The thicker fabric makes them extra comfortable, while the flexible drawstring waistband keeps things easy all day long. Finished with a loose, straight-leg fit and minimal branding on the back pocket, they’re perfect for lounging or running errands. A comfortable choice; you’ll find yourself reaching for them time and time again.


→ 100% Organic Cotton
→ 440GSM - heavy weight
→ Straight leg fit
→ Side panel detail
→ Tonal Adanola branding embroidered on back pocket


How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when wet
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases

This sweatshirt is designed for effortless everyday wear. Crafted from 100% organic cotton, it features an oversized fit with dropped shoulders and a contrast neckline for a relaxed look. Finished with branding on the chest, it's the perfect staple to pair with the matching sweatpants for a laid back look.


→ 100% Organic Cotton
→ Medium weight - 420GSM
→ Contrast washed detail on cuffs and hem
→ Contrast neckline detail

How to care for your organic cotton sweats.

Our new organic cotton is a natural fibre and should be washed with care:

→ Wash cold, on a gentle setting - do not wash on a hot cycle as the natural fibres will warp and reduce in size
→ Avoid using fabric conditioner - it clogs the pores causing the fabric to lose their natural softness
→ Gently reshape when wet
→ Lay flat to dry & make sure to remove from the washer promptly
→ Iron on a warm temp to remove any creases
